description: Refusals any endpoint can give before its own handler runs: bearer (console) and gate-token callers.
applies_to: every endpoint in this directory; approver_forbidden_route applies to every gate route NOT listed here

responses.name: no_token
responses.when: no Authorization: Bearer and no gate token

responses.name: invalid_token
responses.when: the bearer fails verification: bad signature, unknown kid, wrong issuer or audience, expired beyond the leeway, algorithm not RS256/ES256, no usable email claim, or bearer auth not configured

responses.name: not_in_group
responses.when: the bearer verifies but its groups claim lacks the approver group. NOTE: 401, not 403 (the gate treats it as an invalid token); the console's refresh cannot fix it, so after the retry the user is asked to sign in again

responses.name: approver_forbidden_route
responses.when: a bearer (approver) calls any route outside the approver allow-list (e.g. webauthn/revoke, transition, comment); answered before the handler runs

error.const: the approval console's approver role may not call this endpoint

example.error: the approval console's approver role may not call this endpoint
